u0: Regular progress state: no fall is currently awaiting recovery. You normally have the box in hand or are reacquiring it after a completed recovery, and your objective is to head for the exit while ensuring the box is held when you step onto it. If the box falls, the task shifts to u1, where the pickup must happen immediately on the next step.
u1: The box has just fallen and your hands are empty; this is the one-step recovery window. Your next action must pick up the box immediately. A successful pickup returns you to u0 and earns a 0.1 reward; failing to be holding the box on the next state moves you to the absorbing failure state u2.
u2: The box fell and was not picked up on the immediately following step, so the one-step recovery requirement has been missed. This is an absorbing failure state with no further reward; later pickups cannot restore progress, and the episode can no longer succeed under the reward machine.
u3: Final success: you reached the exit while carrying the box, satisfying the task's exit condition. This is the absorbing terminal state and pays the exit reward; no further objective remains.
